name: PlaybookUX
description_en:
PlaybookUX combines research recruitment, moderated and unmoderated methods, analysis and a shared evidence repository.

Its self-serve panel pricing and annual session limit differ from Enterprise access, and newer AI personas need to remain distinguishable from actual participant evidence.
description_zh:
PlaybookUX 将研究招募、主持与无主持方法、分析和共享证据库结合。

自助面板价格及年度会话上限与 Enterprise 权益不同，较新的 AI 人物反馈还需要与真实参与者证据保持可辨别。

core_features.name_en: Research methods and a searchable repository
core_features.name_zh: 研究方法与可搜索证据库
core_features.explanation_en: The platform documents recorded tests, interviews and quantitative methods alongside transcripts, clips, tags and cross-project search.
core_features.explanation_zh: 平台记录录像测试、访谈和定量方法，并提供转录、片段、标签及跨项目搜索。

core_features.name_en: Unlimited seats with bounded research usage
core_features.name_zh: 席位无限、研究用量有界
core_features.explanation_en: Pricing says there is no per-seat charge, while non-Enterprise panel research has 50 sessions per year across methods.
core_features.explanation_zh: 价格页说不按席位收费，但非 Enterprise 面板研究所有方法合计每年 50 个会话。

core_features.name_zh: 可配置 AI 与合成人物
core_features.explanation_en: The site describes AI follow-ups, reports and personas based on research sessions; those generated responses are not new human observations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 网站描述基于研究会话的 AI 追问、报告和人物；生成回答不是新增的人类观察。

sections.title_en: Keep the research round connected to its evidence
sections.title_zh: 让研究与原始证据保持连接
sections.en:
PlaybookUX’s documented workflow covers recruitment, conducting studies, analysis and a repository. It supports unmoderated tasks, moderated interviews, card/tree methods, surveys, first-click, five-second and preference research, with availability dependent on access level. Recordings can be transcribed; researchers can make clips/reels, time-stamped notes, tags and shareable reports and search material across projects.

For a hypothetical onboarding investigation, write one decision question, choose live discussion when follow-up context matters or independent tasks when scheduling is the constraint, then attach findings to specific source moments. A repository is most useful when it retains the task, audience and version context alongside clips. The product’s speed and customer-outcome claims were not independently tested; a centralized repository does not make a weak sample valid.
sections.zh:
PlaybookUX 文档流程涵盖招募、开展研究、分析和证据库。它支持无主持任务、主持访谈、卡片/树方法、问卷、首次点击、五秒及偏好研究，实际开放取决于权限档位。录像可转录，研究者可制作片段/合集、带时间戳笔记、标签和分享报告，并跨项目搜索材料。

以新手引导调查为假设，应先写一个决策问题：重视追问背景时选实时讨论，主要受排期限制时选独立任务，再把发现关联到来源时刻。证据库应同时保留任务、人群、版本和片段上下文。产品速度及客户成果宣传未独立测试，集中存储不能让弱样本自动有效。

sections.title_en: Separate session fees, access upgrades and seats
sections.title_zh: 区分会话费、访问升级与席位
sections.en:
Current self-serve pricing lists unmoderated panel testing at $65 per participant for 10–15 minutes, and moderated interviews at $115 per participant with $55 for each additional 30 minutes. The displayed currency uses dollar symbols; checkout denomination and the base moderated duration were not independently confirmed. The page caps non-Enterprise panel research at 50 sessions annually across methods even though it says concurrent studies and participants per study are not limited.

Optional access upgrades are listed as Scale $5,400/year and Pro $8,800/year, while Enterprise is custom. Card/tree/survey and other methods show upgrade requirements; not every capability in the global feature list is included in basic self-serve. Unlimited seats means no per-seat charge, not free participant recruitment or unlimited annual sessions. BYO participant/CRM access and advanced controls should be confirmed against the actual plan rather than inferred from the homepage.
sections.zh:
当前自助价格列出无主持面板测试每人 $65、10–15 分钟，主持访谈每人 $115，每增加 30 分钟加 $55。页面以美元符号展示；结账币种和主持基础时长未独立确认。尽管页面说不限制并行研究及每研究参与人数，非 Enterprise 面板研究所有方法合计仍每年上限 50 个会话。

可选访问升级列为 Scale 每年 $5,400、Pro 每年 $8,800，Enterprise 定制。卡片/树/问卷等方法显示需升级，不能认为全局功能列表都包含在基础自助档。无限席位表示不按人头收平台费，不代表免费招募或无限年度会话。自带参与者/CRM 和高级控制应按实际套餐确认，不能由首页推断。

sections.title_en: Synthetic participants are generated research material
sections.title_zh: 合成参与者属于生成研究材料
sections.en:
The current site describes AI script/screener checks, follow-up questions, task summaries, executive reports, replay summaries and an API/MCP layer. It says AI features can be configured or switched off. The price page places the detailed AI-enabled suite under Enterprise. Diary studies are marked coming soon; the trial FAQ still refers to a Grow plan while the current upgrade cards name Scale and Pro, so the exact trial entitlement is unresolved.

Synthetic Personas are described as generated from selected video sessions/transcripts and additional prompts, then used in later studies. Such a response is an inference from existing research and a model, not a fresh observation from a recruited human. Label it, preserve its source sessions and verify consequential conclusions with actual target participants. AI question checks likewise cannot guarantee neutral wording or remove sampling bias. No persona, follow-up or generated report was executed.
sections.zh:
现行网站描述 AI 脚本/筛选题检查、追问、任务摘要、管理报告、回放摘要和 API/MCP 层，并说 AI 功能可配置或关闭。价格页将详细 AI 套件列入 Enterprise。日记研究标为即将推出；试用 FAQ 仍提 Grow，而现行升级卡片写 Scale、Pro，因此具体试用权益未解决。

Synthetic Personas 被描述为从选定录像/转录及额外提示生成，再用于后续研究。这类回答是既有研究加模型的推断，不是新招募真人产生的新观察。应标记生成性质、保留来源会话，并向真实目标参与者验证重要结论。AI 问题检查同样不能保证措辞中立或消除抽样偏差。本研究未执行人物、追问或生成报告。

sections.title_en: Design consent and repository access before recording
sections.title_zh: 录制前设计同意和证据库访问
sections.en:
The April 2026 customer terms make the customer responsible for notices, permissions and lawful access to research data. They describe international processing, data-subject assistance and deletion on request after termination where data is no longer needed for the stated purposes. These conditions do not establish automatic immediate deletion of every copy.

Pricing lists custom consent, permissions, workspaces, PII blocking for selected unmoderated tasks and password-protected sharing, with plan-specific access. Inspect those settings and test masking on the actual task before recording sensitive screens. The site’s security certifications,99.99% SLA and all-hours support statements were read as vendor claims, not audited or exercised. The reviewed material did not establish a blanket no-training guarantee or a specific data region for a particular customer.
sections.zh:
2026 年 4 月客户条款将通知、许可和研究数据合法访问责任交给客户，描述跨境处理、协助数据主体，以及终止后按请求删除不再需要用于列明目的的数据。这些条件不证明所有副本会立即自动删除。

价格页列出自定义同意、权限、工作区、特定无主持任务的个人信息遮盖及密码保护分享，实际访问取决于套餐。录制敏感屏幕前，应检查这些设置并用实际任务测试遮盖。网站安全认证、99.99% SLA 和全天支持是厂商声明，未经审计或实际使用。已读材料未建立全面不训练保证，也未确认特定客户的数据地域。

sections.title_en: Agree the usable package and export before cancellation
sections.title_zh: 先确认可用组合，再规划取消前导出
sections.en:
The customer terms put fees and product scope in the applicable order and describe paid subscription, pay-as-you-go and bulk fees as nonrefundable except where law requires otherwise. The public page advertises a signup trial without a credit card but does not resolve the legacy trial-plan name. Ask for the actual methods, annual panel allowance and export/repository access in the selected package rather than treating a feature demo as an entitlement.

A focused evaluation should run a representative task, inspect consent and recording quality, trace one finding to a clip and try the required export or sharing route. This is an editorial validation proposal only. No signup, payment, panel order, interview, export, API/MCP connection or deletion was performed, and no advertised outcome is adopted as a verified result.
sections.zh:
客户条款以实际订单确定费用和产品范围，并描述已付订阅、按量及批量费用除法律要求外不可退款。公开页宣传注册时免信用卡试用，但没有解决旧试用套餐名称。应确认所选组合实际包含的方法、年度面板额度及导出/证据库访问，不能把功能演示视为权益。

聚焦评估可运行一个代表性任务、检查同意和录制质量、将一项发现追溯到片段，并试用所需导出或分享路径。这仅为编辑验证建议。本研究未执行注册、付款、面板订单、访谈、导出、API/MCP 连接或删除，也未将宣传成果作为已验证结果。

research_gaps.zh: 未测试研究、人物、录像、遮盖、面板订单、导出、API/MCP 或取消。
